sloka: तासां मध्यात् समुत्थाय त्रिजटा वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।आत्मानं खादत क्षिप्रं न सीता विनशिष्यति ।। ५.५८.८४ ।।।।
transliteration: tāsāṁ madhyāt samutthāya trijaṭā vākyamabravīt ।ātmānaṁ khādata kṣipraṁ na sītā vinaśiṣyati ।। 5.58.84 ।।।।

translations.english: "From the midst of all of them got up Trijata, saying, 'You eat me if you like. Know that Janaka's daughter is a chaste woman and is the daughterinlaw of Dasaratha. She cannot be destroyed'.
